paths.description: Homepage media listing and primary browse journey; represents the main listing template.
Amateur category listing; represents category and filtered index templates.
Public video detail page; represents the core watch journey and detail template.
Account entry surface; represents registration and consent messaging.
Deliberately invalid URL used to assess HTTP failure recovery.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference is ignored.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe reports eight running 2-second animations and zero prefers-reduced-motion rules while reduce is active.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential animations and autoplay under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, preserving only necessary state feedback.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use declarative View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found no view-transition declarations across the rendered homepage styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route and panel changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Dense page chrome does not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show multiple persistent header and promotion rows; the CSS probe found no scroll-state or scroll-timeline implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse or simplify sticky chrome as content scrolls, using scroll-state container queries where supported and a stable fallback.

findings.summary: Menus and account overlays do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The page exposes multiple dropdown triggers, but the CSS probe found no anchor-name, position-anchor or position-try rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Attach transient menus to their triggers with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: A large cookie overlay obscures the primary content immediately on load.
findings.evidence: Desktop homepage and video-detail screenshots show a centered overlay covering the listing or player before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-blocking consent surface when legally permissible; retain equally prominent accept and reject controls and make dismissal persistent.

findings.summary: The cookie overlay is not exposed as a dialog or popover.
findings.evidence: The visible modal is present, but the platform probe found zero dialog, role=dialog and popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog for the modal consent flow, with a labelled heading, focus containment, Escape handling and restored focus.

findings.summary: Promotional chrome crowds the content hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The first desktop viewport includes two header rows, an age-verification banner, a campaign banner, a persistent sidebar and the cookie overlay before the content grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate promotions, reserve one clear compliance message, and defer secondary campaigns until after the primary content is usable.

findings.summary: The mobile layout renders as a clipped desktop canvas.
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport, layout metrics report client/content width 1024px and 664px horizontal overflow; screenshots clip navigation, content, and the signup panel off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove desktop minimum widths, use intrinsic fluid tracks and responsive breakpoints, and verify scrollWidth never exceeds the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Reused listing and account components do not adapt to their containers.
findings.evidence: The CSS feature probe found no @container rules, while the 360px screenshots show desktop-sized sidebar, grid and signup components extending beyond their containers.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare containment on reusable regions and adapt grids, cards and account panels with size container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is frequently invisible and some targets are too small.
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline-style none and no box shadow on search, login, campaign and icon buttons; Lighthouse also flags 20px targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment and ensure every interactive target has at least 24px safe space, preferably 44px for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: Lab LCP exceeds the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 3.3s; the trace reports LCP 2.52s, placing repeat measurements around or above the 2.5s good boundary.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP resource, reduce early script competition and verify field LCP and INP with real-user monitoring.

findings.summary: The initial delivery has a large request and script surface.
findings.evidence: The HAR contains 142 requests and 1.74MB transferred, including 61 scripts totaling about 1.01MB and 11 stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical dependency chains, defer non-essential scripts, consolidate styles and apply durable caching to versioned static assets.

findings.summary: Substantial unused CSS and JavaScript ship on the homepage.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 57KiB unused CSS, with 87-95% waste in two stylesheets, and 26KiB unused JavaScript in the mobile asset loader.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by route and component, remove duplicated rules and load promotional or account code only when needed.

findings.summary: Several interactive controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility score is 72 and identifies two unnamed buttons plus unnamed live-content links in the tab order.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every icon button and linked thumbnail an accurate accessible name, and avoid nested or competing interactive semantics.

findings.summary: Important text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports contrast ratios of 1.75 and 2.15 on the age banner and 3.29 for view-count text, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose tokens that meet WCAG AA in every theme and verify the age banner, metadata and subscription controls with automated and visual checks.

findings.summary: Focus visibility is not reliable across the navigation and actions.
findings.evidence: Programmatic focus produced outline none and no box shadow for several buttons; this makes keyboard position difficult to track despite logical headings and landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement a consistent :focus-visible ring with sufficient contrast and test a full keyboard traversal of menus, consent and content cards.

findings.summary: The page fails narrow reflow and exposes undersized targets.
findings.evidence: The 360px layout has 664px horizontal overflow and Lighthouse flags targets with only 20px safe height.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow to one viewport without two-dimensional scrolling, preserve user scaling and enlarge touch target hit areas.

findings.summary: Many images lack intrinsic dimensions and several are oversized.
findings.evidence: The image audit finds 29 of 36 images without width/height and 13 delivered at more than twice their display width.
findings.suggestedFix: Set width and height or aspect-ratio on every media thumbnail and serve a responsive candidate close to its rendered size.

findings.summary: Localized indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The homepage has a canonical URL but no hreflang links; robots.txt declares no sitemap and the conventional /sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap index, reference it from robots.txt, and connect localized equivalents with reciprocal hreflang including x-default where appropriate.

findings.summary: Rich listing and video pages expose no JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found zero JSON-LD and zero Open Graph tags on the homepage; representative detail DOM inspection found none as well.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject and site/listing structured data plus Open Graph preview metadata that matches visible content.

findings.summary: First-party cookies and CSP posture are weaker than expected.
findings.evidence: The cookie audit finds x_csrf_token and settings without Secure, with settings also SameSite=None; CSP is limited to frame-ancestors self.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, avoid SameSite=None unless required, protect state tokens with HttpOnly where feasible, and deploy a nonce- or hash-based CSP.

findings.summary: The initial page contacts a broad third-party surface before consent.
findings.evidence: The tracker inventory records 15 third-party origins, with over 100 requests to CDN and collector-related origins during the initial window.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential third parties until consent, reduce origin fan-out, document each processor and batch measurement events.

findings.summary: Account entry does not expose a phishing-resistant passkey option.
findings.evidence: The signup surface offers Google, X and email paths, while DOM and script probes found no WebAuthn or passkey affordance; no permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside federated and email recovery paths, requested in user context.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defenses are missing or narrowly configured.
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and clickjacking protection, but omit X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy; Permissions-Policy only covers two client-hint directives and CSP has no script restrictions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, a strict referrer policy, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy and a full CSP with Trusted Types where the application can support it.

findings.summary: Important overlays and account content are cut off on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: The 360px signup screenshot shows the account panel almost entirely beyond the right edge, and the homepage canvas remains 1024px wide.
findings.suggestedFix: Make overlays and panels viewport-bound, use intrinsic sizes and position fallbacks, and test each state at narrow and zoomed conditions.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and omits stability metadata.
findings.evidence: The image audit reports 13 oversized images, 15 legacy-format resources, 29 missing dimensions and three images without responsive candidates.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate modern responsive variants, choose candidates by rendered size, reserve aspect ratio and lazy-load only below-fold media.

findings.summary: The homepage performs disproportionate background and promotional work.
findings.evidence: The 7-second HAR records 142 requests and 61 scripts, while Lighthouse finds high unused CSS percentages and unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential widgets and promotions, conditionally import route features, and stop background fetches when hidden.

findings.summary: Third-party media and script activity lacks a tight initial-load budget.
findings.evidence: Fifteen third-party origins are contacted and the page transfers 1.74MB before a user begins the core watch flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template request and byte budgets, defer ad and media partners until needed, and monitor third-party cost continuously.
